## Design

### 2026-10-07 – I worked on this project named Intense Scrap, which is a Spotify music controller built around an ESP32 and a small TFT display on it. We can see what is playing and we can just skip the thing forward

**10h**

I worked on this project named Intense Scrap, which is a Spotify music controller built around an ESP32 and a small TFT display on it. We can see what is playing and we can just skip the thing forward or backward. There are three physical controls for that: play, pause, and next. The device will have a rechargeable battery and with the compact custom PCB with the electronics enclosed in a small portable case, the project focuses on learning PCB design. I learn about the PCB design and all the things which I'm learning now and doing at first so it's taking time to understand how to build it.

### 2026-10-08 – Spent another 9 hours developing Intense Scrap and improving the overall project design. I worked on refining the PCB concept, checking the component list, and making the BOM more realistic for locall

**9h**

Spent another 9 hours developing Intense Scrap and improving the overall project design. I worked on refining the PCB concept, checking the component list, and making the BOM more realistic for locally available parts. I also continued working on the enclosure and how the display, buttons, battery, USB-C and headphone connection will fit together inside the case.
I spent time reviewing the ESP32 pin connections and thinking through how the TFT display and physical controls will work together. I also looked more closely at the power section and the requirements for the rechargeable battery and headphone output.
The project is looking much more complete than before, but it is not finished yet. There are still some important things I need to finalize, especially the exact audio circuit, production footprints, PCB routing, and proper ERC/DRC checks before the board can actually be manufactured. I also want to test the electronics separately before committing to the final PCB.
